name: Upkyk Assistant AI
author: Upkyk

sections.description:
Upkyk Assistant AI – Smarter Conversations for Your WordPress Site

Upkyk Assistant AI adds a modern, fully customizable AI chatbot to your WordPress site. It helps you provide instant, AI-powered support to your visitors using OpenAI or DeepSeek—without relying on external platforms or third-party dashboards.

Assist your visitors faster and smarter with a chatbot that matches your branding and runs directly inside WordPress.

Core Features

  • Modern, responsive chat interface
  • AI-generated replies using OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-5) or DeepSeek-V3 (your API key)
  • Train the chatbot with your own phrases or service summaries
  • Customize appearance: colors, fonts, and positioning
  • Choose chatbot visibility (all pages or specific ones)
  • WordPress dashboard integration – no external tools needed
  • Optional consent popup for GDPR/AVG compliance
  • Privacy-friendly: no data storage by default

🚀 Pro Version – Unlock More Power

Upgrade to Assistant AI Pro and get access to:

  • Train the AI with your own documents (TXT, CSV, JSON)
  • Smarter reasoning using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Integrate your own knowledge base
  • Add quick reply suggestions
  • Use trigger keywords for targeted responses
  • WhatsApp or email handover for live chat escalation
  • Store chat history (fully GDPR/AVG-compliant)
  • Trigger-based lead capture with contact form integration
  • Schedule chatbot active hours
  • Enhanced design customization (icons, behavior, animations)

👉 Learn more about Assistant AI Pro

🔐 Privacy & External Services

To provide AI responses, user messages are securely sent (HTTPS) to OpenAI or DeepSeek using your API key.
No user data is stored by the plugin unless explicitly enabled in the Pro version.

OpenAI Terms | OpenAI Privacy
DeepSeek Terms | DeepSeek Privacy

For more details, visit our privacy policy.

Privacy Policy

Upkyk Assistant AI connects to external AI services to process user chat messages. When a user interacts with the chatbot, their messages are sent directly from your website to these services to generate appropriate responses.

Important privacy points:

  • No chat data is stored or processed on our servers.
  • All communication is encrypted (HTTPS) and occurs directly between your website and the AI service using your API key.
  • The plugin may store conversation data locally in your WordPress database if enabled.
  • We have no access to your users’ chat data or your API key.

To use this plugin in compliance with privacy regulations:

  1. Update your website’s privacy policy to disclose the use of AI chat services.
  2. Inform users that their chat messages are processed by external AI services.
  3. Obtain appropriate consent before enabling the chatbot.

For more details, visit our privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/upkyk-assistant-ai directory, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Use the Assistant AI settings page to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your API key for your chosen AI service.
  5. Customize appearance settings as desired.
sections.faq:
Is an API key required from OpenAI or DeepSeek?

Yes. You must generate and add your own API key from either OpenAI or DeepSeek in the Assistant AI settings. This ensures secure, direct communication between your website and the AI service. Setting it up takes just a few minutes.

Both platforms require you to fund your own account, but the good news is: with as little as €2–€5, you can often run the Assistant AI for many weeks, especially if your usage is moderate. It’s a cost-effective way to add smart AI to your site without ongoing subscriptions.

This is a smart alternative to many AI chat platforms that charge €90 to €245 per month or more, often based on the number of chats or visitors. By using your own API key, you keep full control over your costs and usage, without any hidden fees or imposed limits.

  • Create a DeepSeek account at: https://platform.deepseek.com
  • Create an OpenAI account at: https://platform.openai.com

Does this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, Upkyk Assistant AI works with any WordPress theme. The chat interface is added via JavaScript and doesn’t rely on theme templates.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can customize colors, fonts, positioning, avatar, and more in the Appearance tab of the plugin settings.

Is user data secure?

All communication with AI services is encrypted (HTTPS). User chat messages are processed directly by your selected AI provider and are not stored on our servers. Please review and update your own privacy policy for compliance. See the “Privacy Policy” section below for details.

  • Updated DeepSeek integration to support DeepSeek-V3 Chat and Reasoner models
  • Improved API diagnostics page with GPT-5 and DeepSeek-V3 model testing
  • Enhanced AI service class with automatic API routing for GPT-5 models
  • Added Sales & E-commerce personality type (Pro feature preview)
  • Updated all language translations for new features
  • Improved response parsing for both Chat Completions and Responses API formats
  • Tested compatibility with WordPress 6.9

  • Simplified chat interface and improved animations
  • Enhanced admin preview functionality
  • Improved icon selection modal
  • Optimized avatar size for better visual balance

1.0.1 – 2025-05-07

  • Enhanced compatibility and performance
